statusText: Tail eases to 10%. Mapped policy state: EA_ON. A fourth Globex hour returned NQ from the band high to within nine points of the band low, the cleanest mean-reversion datapoint of the overnight session, while Stress firms to 50% on Brent above $102 and multi-decade-high long-end yields.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON, with Tail in the low band and well below the block threshold. The narrow danger window spans the 13:30Z US cash open through 15:00Z, where an opening-auction continuation with shallow pullbacks would be the first meaningful Tail evidence of the session. The 17:00Z 30-Year Bond Auction, with the 30Y near its highest since May 2002, remains the clearest delayed-second-leg mechanism later in the day. Existing-position management and emergency protection are unaffected.
headline: Nasdaq-100 futures complete a full overnight-band round trip as Asian cash keeps lifting off its low
body: A fourth Globex hour is now observed and it produced the clearest mean-reversion evidence of the overnight session. The band widened only marginally, to 31,372.25-31,466.00, and NQ Dec26 now trades 31,381.50, -0.07% against a 31,402.25 prior close. That is nine points above the band low, after the contract sat at 31,442.50 in the upper third an hour earlier. A complete round trip of a roughly 94-point band in one hour is the opposite of directional efficiency: there is no repeated extension, no failed retracement and no sustained hold near either extreme. The Oct 7 cash session says the same thing. The Nasdaq-100 closed 31,160.08, -0.21%, after a dip to 30,904.46 was fully retraced into a close just 10 points below the 31,170.12 high. Asian cash continues to mean-revert rather than cascade. The Nikkei 225 trades 69,373.40, -0.95%, about 178 points above its 69,195.47 session low against a 70,035.71 prior close, a third consecutive hour of improvement from the -1.11% print near the low. The Hang Seng is the mild counterweight at roughly 24,012.92, -0.49%, close to its 24,009.36 session low, so Asian equities are not uniformly recovering; that divergence reduces directional conviction rather than establishing a one-way path. Megacap and semiconductor evidence is neutral overnight: Nvidia closed 237.47, -0.74%, and trades 237.49 in the overnight session, essentially unchanged. The macro backdrop stays more stressed than the price path. The September 15-16 FOMC minutes, released Oct 7, show most participants judging that another increase in the federal funds target range would likely be appropriate by year end, with the range now 3-3/4 to 4 percent. On Oct 7 the 10-year reached 5.36 percent intraday, its highest since April 2002, and the 30-year reached 5.73 percent, its highest since May 2002, before closing at about 5.28 and 5.66 percent respectively; pulling back from the highs is itself a sign of orderly repricing. H.15 carries the 2-year at 4.79 percent for Oct 6. VIX settled at 15.08 after a 16.01 intraday print, a low absolute level. Crude has firmed further, with Brent near 102.23, up about 2.0 percent, and WTI near 89.91, up about 1.8 percent, against reported attacks in the Strait of Hormuz and a Gulf storm threatening offshore production. Under the repository contract this combination of hawkish rate-path repricing, firmer crude and mixed Asian cash informs Stress and Confidence rather than Tail, because no persistent one-way NQ structure, shallow-pullback sequence or repeated extension after a failed retracement has been observed. Tail therefore eases to 10 percent and Stress firms to 50 percent. The shared Finviz context file is dated Sep 29 with partial collection status, roughly nine days stale, so it was not used as current evidence; this run's research was independent and primary-source based.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding clock-hours carry published Claude assessments. Tail ran 10-14% through the Asian and European hours of Oct 7, rose into a 20-23% WATCH band between 11:00Z and 15:00Z as a trend-down phase developed into the US open, then decayed to 11-18% once the dip to 30,904.46 was fully retraced into the cash close. The overnight hours since 20:00Z have held 11-13% with no WATCH print. Stress held a 45-54% elevated band and Confidence stayed in the high band at 87-89%.
outlookSummary: Base case is continued two-way NQ rotation while multi-decade-high long-end yields, firmer crude and mixed Asian cash remain the dominant background conflict. Conditional Tail holds 10-11% through the Asian hours, rises to 13-17% across the European session and the 08:30Z Waller speech, reaches a 21% peak in the hour containing the 13:30Z US cash open, eases to 17-20% through the US morning, returns to 20% for the 17:00Z 30-Year Bond Auction and the 17:40Z Musalem speech, then decays to 11-15% after the 20:00Z cash close. Stress tracks 48-56% with peaks at the open and the auction. The long-bond auction, with the 30Y near its 2002 highs, is the clearest credible delayed-second-leg mechanism in the window.

forecastDetail.comment: A fourth observed Globex hour carried NQ from the 31,466.00 band high back to 31,381.50, nine points off the 31,372.25 low; that full round trip plus the Nikkei's lift off 69,195.47 keeps cross-asset conflict a Stress input rather than a Tail input.
Base case is a fifth rotational hour inside the same band on thin Asian liquidity; the first invalidation would be a break of either band edge that then holds with shallow pullbacks.
Tokyo afternoon tests whether the Nikkei holds its recovery off 69,195.47 against a far higher 69,918.20 session high, with the Hang Seng near its own low as a mild conflict signal.
The Tokyo close into the European pre-open is a liquidity trough that rarely sets persistent structure, though an Asian close on the lows would hand Europe a directional lean.
European cash opens here as the first liquid test of the overnight band; a push holding outside either edge with shallow pullbacks would be the day's earliest mean-reversion-failure signature.
Waller speaks at 08:30Z with the September minutes pointing to another increase by year end, so rate-path headline risk lifts conditional Tail modestly without implying a no-retracement path.
